selected_evidence.requirement: Use software compatible with the installed legacy platform while retaining OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10 repository packages rsync/rsync-daemon 3.5.0-3.el10_2 were installed. Final audits retain RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.

selected_evidence.requirement: Publish a read-only module named releases on node1 with narrowly scoped security controls
selected_evidence.summary: The module is chrooted to the release directory, explicitly read-only, allowed only from node2, enabled at boot, protected by a source-specific firewall rule, and uses a narrowly scoped SELinux label while write/full-access booleans remain off.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 retrieves the full tree with file modes and symlinks intact
selected_evidence.summary: Both initial and final post-restart archive transfers retrieved 2 files, 3 directories, and 1 symlink; mode 0755, mode 0644, `current -> v1`, and both file hashes were verified.

selected_evidence.requirement: Writes through the module and access outside its tree are denied
selected_evidence.summary: Uploads returned `module is read only`; `private` returned `Unknown module`; traversal resolved inside the chroot and failed. Node1 confirmed no probe files were created.
Final release and private-canary hashes, modes, ownership, sizes, and symlink target match the pre-change baselines on both nodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 22045032-4379-47d6-bbf6-319fdca89750 to 97fd7428-0b06-4c0f-ba41-9b413081fd81. Rsyncd, listener, firewall, labels, data, retrieval, and denial behavior recovered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node2 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a to 896f3799-abc8-4666-a80f-3fc65e37ea56. The client, protected data, administrative services, and complete end-to-end workflow recovered.

No introduced temporary residue remains. SSH/firewalld are active, SELinux is enforcing, node2 has no rsync listener, node1 exposes only the intended rsync listener behind its restricted rule, and no rsync AVC denials were recorded.

set -eu

uname -r

printf 'module-list\n'
rsync "rsync://$NODE1_IP/"
printf 'final-archive-transfer\n'

printf 'probe\n' > "$UPLOAD"
set +e
rsync "$UPLOAD" "rsync://$NODE1_IP/releases/final-write-test"
WRITE_RC=$?
rsync --list-only "rsync://$NODE1_IP/private/"
PRIVATE_RC=$?
rsync --list-only "rsync://$NODE1_IP/releases/../private/signing-policy.txt"
TRAVERSAL_RC=$?
set -e
printf 'write-exit=%s private-module-exit=%s traversal-exit=%s\n' "$WRITE_RC" "$PRIVATE_RC" "$TRAVERSAL_RC"
[ "$WRITE_RC" -ne 0 ]
[ "$PRIVATE_RC" -ne 0 ]
[ "$TRAVERSAL_RC" -ne 0 ]
printf 'node2-protected-data\n'
sha256sum /srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/releases/v1/README /srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/releases/v1/bin/client /srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/private/signing-policy.txt

rm -rf -- "$TESTDIR"
rm -f -- "$UPLOAD"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'final-security-and-cleanup=pass\n'
